title: [CS] SCP Survival Additions
body:
# THIS MOD IS UNOFFICAL AND IS NOT PARTNERS WITH "CORE & SPRING"
## Summary
The purpose of the mod is to add survival friendly options to obtain SCP's from the [CS] SCP mod.

## Currently Supported SCPs From This Mod

**For All Recipes Please Download [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)**

**For a Tutorial on How to Make SCP-914, Watch This Video by The Original Creator** 

[SCP 914 Overview](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ni83yqWQGxc)
